title: ColGrep-Agent-2B Cuts Coding Agent API Tokens 34%
summary:
An open-source expert model designed for local execution now manages file retrieval for AI coding assistants. This tool, named ColGrep-Agent-2B, contains 2B parameters and functions as a "model-in-the-middle" to find and read files on a user's own machine. By processing search tasks locally and returning only the necessary data to the primary agent, the system reduces API token consumption by 34%.

The model utilizes ColGREP, a hybrid search tool that combines standard grep features with multi-vector retrieval to identify code locations. Because the process runs 100% locally, developers can avoid sending large volumes of codebase information to external providers for basic search operations.
